description: For a selection bigger than update_records/delete_records can take in one call (over 5000 ids): runs as a durable, chunked, resumable background job instead of one request. Returns immediately with a job id — poll get_bulk_record_job with it to see progress. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES enqueue_bulk_record_job"]

values.description: Required when op is "update"; omit for "delete".
